_meta.title: UNET
_meta.note: Loads the flux1-schnell diffusion model from a 4-bit GGUF quant (fits 8GB VRAM). This is the design-permitted fallback while krea2 has no weights on disk. The ComfyClient ban-check reads unet_name here.

_meta.title: CLIP
_meta.note: Flux needs two text encoders: clip_l (short tag understanding) + t5xxl fp8 (long natural-language prompts). Both live in ComfyUI/models/clip on the SSD.

_meta.title: VAE
_meta.note: Flux autoencoder (ae.safetensors) that turns the denoised latent back into pixels at node 15.

_meta.title: PROMPT_POS
_meta.note: The assembled sd_prompt lands here (patched per shot by ComfyClient: character anchors + location anchor + composition + style tail, 120-word budget). Also reused as the 'negative' input on node 14 because schnell runs CFG 1.0, where the negative is ignored.

_meta.title: GUIDANCE
_meta.note: Flux's distilled-guidance knob (not classic CFG). 3.5 is the standard default: higher = stricter prompt following but stiffer images.

_meta.title: LATENT
_meta.note: Blank 16-channel latent canvas (flux uses the SD3-style latent space, hence this node instead of EmptyLatentImage). Patched to 1216x704 for panels/plates, 832x1216 portrait for character refs.

_meta.title: SAMPLER
_meta.note: The actual denoising loop. schnell is step-distilled: 4 steps, euler, cfg 1.0 is the intended recipe (more steps does NOT improve it). SEED is patched per shot from hash(scene_id, shot_id, retry) so every panel is reproducible from its sidecar json.

_meta.title: DECODE
_meta.note: Latent -> RGB pixels via the VAE from node 3.

_meta.title: SAVE
_meta.note: Writes the PNG under ComfyUI/output/<SAVE_PREFIX>; ComfyClient then copies it into the project's panels/refs directory and renames it deterministically.
